## Question
Check if the fare distribution is skewed.

## Expected answer format
@skewness_fare[skewness_value], where "skewness_value" is a float rounded to 2 decimal places, representing the skewness of the fare distribution.

After analyzing the data, submit your answer with final_answer(your_answer_here) in the specified format.
